A THOUGHTFUL STATIC ADAPTATION

History has layers.
So does the evidence.

The specified application uses Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, a backend session and HTTP API. This independent static demonstration uses browser-only HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Its role selector demonstrates interface visibility, not access control; local records reset on refresh.

The original design calls for Leaflet with attributed OpenStreetMap tiles, English/German route localization, server-rendered authenticated pages, CSRF-protected edits and runtime developer links. This English-only preview uses an original offline schematic map instead. No real login, translation service, backend, health endpoint or metrics collector runs here.

Select a marker or list entry to inspect a place. Switch to a demo Editor role to try a small local form. Confidence and references remain part of the detail, rather than implied certainty.
